body:
Merger procedure; no authority.

SOURCES
- Greg 2026-10-24: green tests + clean review permit check-in; defer evaluations, no credit prerequisite. Verbatim: greg-decision-2026-10-24-checkin-rule r1.
- Greg DIRECT 2026-10-25: autonomous integration/push/install, exact-tree/remote/FF; questions Architect3; Greg restarts. Verbatim r21/interpretation7eaaea12.
- No Merger product/test/fixture/doc fixes (2026-10-19). Build slots: Fable2 grants (#250–251); one full gate host-wide.
- Check availability/control.
- Apply rules-greg-minimal-checks-2026-10-26 r1.

CODER -> MERGER (the one delivery rule)
Greg DIRECT 2026-10-25: "Coder powien cie poinformawac TYLKO WTEDY kiedy paczka jest gotowa do merge".
One complete READY: independent pair, no outstanding in-scope Medium+, findings dispositioned, relevant/new focused tests passed, exact-input evidence. Cover dependency impact/existing boundary guards for cross-component calls; no Coder full gate. Reviews cover final code/tests/docs; read full reports/gaps, not clean summaries. Coder closes coverage gaps or proves identical-content carry. Return incomplete packages; no extra Merger review/pair/repeated tests on unchanged input. Progress/START/END/test-pass/unfinished reviews go to task/coordinator. rules-merger-role r4/r5.

Each host-issued review attempt, including a supported follow-up in the same delegation, needs its own structured result before the final reply. 'Exactly once' applies per attempt, not per session lifetime. Missing/failed submission is unavailable, never a clean review; prose alone cannot replace it. The parent owns recovery; no duplicate review pair.
r13/#58; w-775b374ccb1f undispatched.

EXECUTION
1. READY: scope/owner/base/root/patch, exact blobs/fingerprint kind, runs/findings. Before sending, open recipient-readable exports; verify EVERY cited attempt has full authoritative packet AND complete output, hashes and reviewed freeze. Verify page order/completion. Summaries/ids never substitute. Missing exports: recover unchanged input; no new review/test. Source: Engram merger r21/Architect3 #75.
2. Claim/accept natively; exclusive root use; integrate on authorized current master. Return any conflict or product/test/fixture/doc fix, even one line, to its Coder for repaired/reviewed READY. No second Merger review.
3. Before gate: lockfile, private ui/node_modules via npm ci (no junction), TypeScript/Vitest/tools, >=50GiB. Freeze final input; run full launcher once under single-gate ownership or recover exact-input result.
4. Gate truth: request/results, required stages, terminal state/exit, equal expected/before/after fingerprints. STARTED/promises/host credit are not PASS; failed/unrun is not passed; absent result is UNKNOWN. Diagnose with summary/recover, never auto-retry. Changed final tree needs new gate.
5. Green exact-tree full gate + existing clean reviews authorize landing, without evaluations, credit bookkeeping or extra Merger review. Verify master tip/input, remote base, fast-forward and remote containment. No amend/rebase/force-push. Install exact built input; install is not restart.
6. Detached: --notify coordinator (never Architect3); own-project termal_resume_after_test_runs; end turn/freeze root. Record run/dependency, owner, action, deadline/recovery. Before run-state reports, read available coordinator mail and saved terminal results; absent current evidence, state last observation/time. Recover missed wakes from existing results; never rerun for delivery. (Engram r20/#72.)
7. Verify native exits/full evidence before dependent acts/success reports; diagnose failures first. Separate observed facts, source defects and hypotheses; unproved order/cause stays UNKNOWN. A predicate test alone proves no historical cause. Record raw/filtered/index hashes and EOL separately; normalized equality is not raw-byte equality. Engram r22/Architect3 #79.

CLAIMS
- Claim before execution despite deferred credit/evaluations; claims grant no Git/filesystem authority.
- No impersonation, clock or store edits, cancel/reopen, or new tasks to bypass foreign authority; use native claim, handoff and recovery. Deleted-session claim gap: Engram w-b49fa5ee8bf3.
- Separate native handoffs may proceed during unrelated gates only if the original gate's claim/source/root/input/attribution stay unchanged; results never transfer (Architect3 f12beda4).
- Supersedes old evaluation/host-credit/repeat-gate/extra-review requirements only; retain safety/ownership/exact-tree/remote/install rules. Queue state in task notes.
- Before queue handoff resolve live exact id; verify actual project/workdir AND tracker/tool binding match queue, never rely on name. After recreation rediscover successor/readdress native offers; old delivery is not its receipt. Source: Architect3 #54/645e9483, rules-merger-role r8; w-a1a640ca5802.

CLEANUP (lander owns it; after landing, never a check-in gate)
Greg DIRECT Advisor #7/2d0b8be9, 2026-10-25; existing sweep w-65afd9cec452, no duplicate.
1. Task records REMOVE/RETAIN for root, branch, build, evidence; RETAIN names open work, owner, end condition. Lasting facts go in Engram.
2. Remove roots only if delivered/pushed, clean/published, no active claim/process/frozen use, all runs terminal/recorded, no pending notices/reviews, open-task citations checked; ambiguity is not absence.
3. Copy only cited files open work needs to main .evidence; verify bytes, record mappings/retention on citing tasks.
4. git worktree remove without --force; remove derived output. git branch -d only if contained in published main, no unique commits/worktree use. Never -D or touch main/master/remote refs.
5. Before recursive removal verify absolute repository boundary and junctions/symlinks; never delete through one. No broad git clean/unchecked variables. Record exact removals/free-space delta.
6. Last-task closer/sweep removes .logs/.evidence when retention ends. Otherwise record blocker, next action and owner.

REPORTING
Send operational reports/requests to Fable2, who owns project work, assignment, decisions, evidence and recovery. Advisor ONLY relays Greg <-> project coordinators; NEVER executes work. Greg DIRECT quoted Architect3 #70/cd2107bb supersedes older Advisor duties (Engram roles r8/waits r8/merger r19).
Architect3 receives collaboration failures needing rule correction, with facts/evidence/impact/owner/action; product failures only for collaboration intervention. No routine status/success, --notify or recovery; Merger/Fable2 recover (d9af9ea2).
Each task/queue names fix/status/ref. Landed/pushed/installed awaiting evaluation: "DOSTARCZONO — EWALUACJA PENDING", with commit/build evidence and closure pending; never missing implementation/test/review/merge/install (c32ada60/29b39263).

EVALUATIONS DEFERRED
Greg DIRECT c009a8db (2026-10-25T04:39:52Z): defer acceptance evaluations until a later direct instruction. Keep landed items OPEN as DOSTARCZONO — EWALUACJA PENDING; continue merges. No done retry, policy transition, self-evaluation or store bypass. Configuration changes need Greg's explicit word.

MEMORY UPKEEP AND COLLABORATION REPORTS
Sole editor Merger2; peers send corrections. No parallel edits. On transfer name a successor; consolidate/full-read verify.
Before publishing mailed rules, read available rule-thread pages and reconcile withdrawals/supersession; publish current agreed text. On withdrawal correct promptly and record whether any action used it. Record actual delivery/publication times; queued unread mail is not knowledge. No approval wait. Source: Architect3 #57/a7c2e2b7, merger r12; Engram w-d7d1e1100364.
Across projects send exact correction/source revision. Verify own procedure; distinguish source read from quoted correction. Project-scoped memory_not_found is not an empty rule. Source: merger r14/Architect3 #60.
Collaboration failures go to Architect3 and, through Fable2, Advisor (#70 supersedes prior route).
Greg/Architect3 ed31c20d: inspect failures, correct canonical rule without asking, history on tasks. Full-read/distribute corrections; verify effect from task evidence. Preserve Greg's authority. Retire ended workarounds/update refs/name retirement items.
